name: NVSHMEM: Parallel programming interface for NVIDIA GPU clusters
notes: NVSHMEM is based on OpenSHMEM. Creates global address space across multiple GPUs. GPU-initiated operations, CPU-initiated operations, stream-based operations. v3.8 adds: host/device RMA regions, counted-signal APIs, multicast logical endpoints, CUDA 13.4 features for Vera Rubin. Key for multi-GPU inference serving.
